description: Read-only central-directory inventory without decompressing anything: every entry (duplicates included) in directory order as a full row — name + encoding, sizes, ratio, CRC-32, method, timestamp, decoded flags, Unix mode, symlink, Zip64, data descriptor, host system, offsets, named extra fields, the sanitized path an extraction would use (null = unsafe name), comment. `filter` selects by exact names / prefix / globs; `offset` + `limit` page (default 200, max 2000, `hasMore`). Prefer inspect_zip for a one-shot summary and read_zip_entry / extract_zip for content. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' → names only; fields:[…].

fields.description: Dot-path projection applied after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); array segments map over elements; unmatched paths are reported in _meta.unmatchedFields.

filter.description: Select entries by name. `names` (exact, case-sensitive), `prefix` (path prefix) and `glob` (patterns: `*` within a segment, `**` across segments, `?` one character; a pattern without `/` matches at any depth, a trailing `/` matches a whole subtree) are ANDed when several are given; `includeDirectories` (default false) keeps explicit directory entries.

glob.description: Glob patterns; an entry matching ANY pattern is kept (e.g. ['**/*.json', 'docs/']).

includeDirectories.description: Keep explicit directory entries (names ending in `/`).

names.description: Exact entry names to keep (case-sensitive; every duplicate of a name is kept).

prefix.description: Keep entries whose name starts with this prefix (e.g. 'src/').

includeExtraData.description: Include each extra field payload as base64 (forensics).

limit.description: Return at most this many entries (default 200, max 2000); `hasMore` tells you to page.

limits.description: Override zipnative's named security bounds for this call (CWE-400 / CWE-409 guards). Every key is optional; absent keys keep the engine defaults (maxEntries 100000, maxEntryUncompressedSize 1 GiB, maxTotalUncompressedSize 8 GiB, maxCompressionRatio 1024, maxNameBytes 4096, maxExtraFieldBytes 65535, maxCommentBytes 65535, maxCentralDirectoryBytes 256 MiB). Values above the operator ceilings (ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES, ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES) are refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise a bound for trusted input only.

maxCompressionRatio.description: Maximum declared uncompressed/compressed ratio for entries >= 1 KiB compressed (zip-bomb guard).

maxEntryUncompressedSize.description: Maximum decompressed size of one entry, bytes.

maxExtraFieldBytes.description: Maximum extra-field block length in bytes.

maxTotalUncompressedSize.description: Maximum total decompressed size across an extraction, bytes.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine diagnostic (prepended data, duplicate name, name mismatch, …) to a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of reporting it.

validate.description: 'lazy' (default) parses the central directory only; 'eager' also cross-checks every local header up front.

verbosity.description: 'summary' returns only the scalar verdict fields (drops arrays and payloads) — the token-frugal form.

zipBase64.description: The archive bytes as base64 (exactly once; a data: URI prefix is tolerated). Exclusive with zipPath. Decoded size ≤ 128 MiB.

zipPath.description: Relative path of an archive inside the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (no absolute paths, no '..'; container extensions only: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64. Lets a create/modify → verify/extract chain avoid re-sending the bytes.

name: list_zip_entries

outputSchema.description: Paged entry listing. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

diagnosticCount.description: summary only: number of distinct diagnostics.

diagnosticCounts.description: Number of diagnostics received per code (counts every occurrence, including de-duplicated ones).

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal conformance concerns the engine raised while parsing or writing (de-duplicated by code + entry, at most 200). Empty for a clean archive. Codes: ZIP_PREPENDED_DATA, ZIP_MULTIPLE_EOCD, ZIP_NAME_MISMATCH, ZIP_UNICODE_PATH_CONFLICT, ZIP_INVALID_UTF8_NAME, ZIP_DUPLICATE_NAME, ZIP_EXTRA_FIELD_MALFORMED, ZIP_ZIP64_EXTRA_IGNORED, ZIP_TIMESTAMP_NOT_PINNED, ZIP_NONDETERMINISTIC_CODEC, ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: Present (true) when more than 200 distinct diagnostics were dropped from `diagnostics`.

crc32.description: CRC-32 of the uncompressed data, 8 lowercase hex digits.

index.description: Position in the central directory (or in the forward scan).

isSymlink.description: Unix mode S_IFLNK; null from a forward scan.

lastModified.description: ISO-8601 (DOS time has 2-second granularity; UT extra refines it).

sanitizedPath.description: The relative path a secure extraction would use; null when the name cannot be made safe (traversal, absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, ADS, device name).

unixMode.description: Octal permission bits when Unix-authored ('0644'), else null.

entryCount.description: Entries in the central directory (before filtering).

matchedCount.description: Entries kept by the filter (before paging).

names.description: summary only: the names on this page.

title: List entries (paged inventory)
